title: A clearer view of model health
summary:
A clearer model monitor, better image-worker failover, and API errors that point to the right payer.

The model monitor now separates Official and Community models. Health percentages and outage badges reflect the selected group, and models with no traffic in the selected window stay out of the results.

FLUX and DreamShaper requests can try another pool worker after a 503 or known network failure. DreamShaper also limits its local queue, so excess requests can move to a worker with capacity instead of waiting in a long backlog.

Provider-returned 402 errors are now reported as 502 Bad Gateway rather than suggesting the user's wallet or API-key budget is the problem. Actual Pollinations payment failures remain 402.

highlights.title: Model health by ownership
highlights.text: Switch between Official and Community models in the model monitor. Health percentages and outage badges follow the selected group, without counting models that had no traffic. [Open the model monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
